title: Ingestion Agent Output Schema
description: Common output contract for all 4 ingestion agents (price, weather, outage, regulatory). Every agent MUST emit an array of items conforming to this shape so the cross-referencing and synthesis agents can consume them uniformly.

source.description: Which ingestion agent produced this file

region.description: Grid/state scope for this project run

as_of_date.description: The trading/business date this data pertains to (YYYY-MM-DD)

generated_at.description: Timestamp the agent produced this output (ISO 8601)

headline.description: One-line summary of the item, plain language

detail.description: Fuller structured detail; must be traceable to source_reference values, no embellishment

source_reference.description: URL, file path, or bulletin ID the item was extracted from

source_timestamp.description: When the underlying source data was published/observed

delta_from_previous.description: What changed vs. the prior day's equivalent item; null if this is a new item with no prior comparison

grid_zone.description: Optional: sub-region/zone within Karnataka (e.g. Bengaluru Urban, Hubli-Dharwad) used by the cross-referencing agent to detect compounded risk

raw_values.description: Source-specific structured fields (e.g. price: {mcp_rs_per_mwh, block}; weather: {temp_c, forecast_confidence}; outage: {plant_name, mw_capacity, duration_hours}; regulatory: {filing_type, commission})
